description: The MILES empirical stellar library (Medium-resolution INT Library of Empirical Spectra): 985 observed stars, 3525-7500 A at 2.5 A FWHM, published at research.iac.es/proyecto/miles as one official FITS tarball plus the joined parameter table. The spectra = Sánchez-Blázquez et al. 2006; the parameters and the re-assessed resolution = Falcón-Barroso et al. 2011; v9.1 is the site's file revision. stellarlib's release label is 2011 (the parameter set's literature year); v9.1 is recorded in provenance.
license: no license statement found on the site (2026-11-17); research use with the references cited

verified.per_file_urls: s0001.fits and s0985.fits HEAD-checked 200 (23,040 bytes each); the per-file channel exists beside the tarball
verified.out_of_product: the site also publishes MILES_library_v9.1_ASCII.tar.gz (43,665,541 bytes; the same 985 spectra re-encoded as ASCII) and the CaT library (a different library); neither is part of this product

format_notes: one FITS per star: REDUCEME product, primary image HDU with NAXIS2=1, NAXIS1=4367, BITPIX=-32; flux pixels verbatim (negatives included); no flux unit keyword
wavelength from the header's linear WCS: CRPIX1=1.0, CRVAL1=3500.0, CDELT1=0.9 A/pix, giving 3500.0-7429.4 A — the pixel domain; the cited coverage window is 3525-7500 A

the parameter table is fixed-width ASCII (columns located by the header labels Name/MILES/CaT/SpT/Teff/log g/[Fe/H]/Refs/Libraries); '--' marks a not-reported value; Refs encodes the parameter provenance codes and Libraries the star's membership letters (verbatim facts, never interpreted)
the FITS header carries OBJECT (star name), FITSFI (file name), AIRMASS (0.0), TIMEXPO (-999.0 sentinel) — REDUCEME header facts, preserved as stated

references.citation: Falcón-Barroso, J., et al. 2011, A&A 532, A95
